name: FORGE
features: New Strength Progression Lab within Train: select any exercise for logged performance trends
Completed-set-only strength/load charts and verified historical personal-best status
Conservative next-session target suggestions based on actual reps, weight and exercise ranges
Bodyweight/time movements tracked without invented weights or calculated one-rep-max estimates
Progression module is read only and does not overwrite any workout entries or saved routines
Existing v47 artwork and enlarged mobile navigation are retained
